ServiceRequest.identity: immutable SOMA entity identity plus official eight-digit or governed local business identity
ServiceRequest.role: pivotal operational correlation context, not universal aggregate parent

RFC.identity: immutable SOMA entity identity plus canonical NC+14 business identity when official
RFC.hierarchy_role: derived from parent/child relationships: parentless root; root with children is Master; child is Subordinate
RFC.customer: zero or one current canonical Customer Organization; unresolved is explicit
RFC.status: ticket lifecycle/source projection owned here; provider evidence and local downstream consequence remain distinct

WorkingNote.ownership: SOMA-owned ticket history; never overwritten by source import

relationships.service_request_to_rfc: many-to-many direct links terminate only at master/root RFCs; subordinate SR context is inherited through hierarchy
relationships.rfc_hierarchy: acyclic one-parent forest with at most two RFC levels; a Subordinate can never parent another RFC
relationships.rfc_to_device_reference: zero-to-many direct operational Device Reference context is allowed even with no linked SR; subordinate RFC context may differ from its root/master
relationships.device_reference_resolution: RFC relationship remains to Device Reference whether it stays unregistered or resolves to an Infrastructure Network Element
relationships.wfm_to_rfc: each WFM belongs to exactly one RFC; WFM/Task lifecycle and scheduling are HLD-06 authority
relationships.local_task_to_rfc: Local Task may reference zero-to-many RFCs under HLD-06; this does not create RFC ownership of Task lifecycle

hierarchy_constraints.provider_inference: provider/import evidence never silently creates hierarchy
hierarchy_constraints.resolved_customer_consistency: resolved branch members share canonical Customer Organization identity; unresolved ownership remains a warning/state
hierarchy_constraints.reparent_after_wfm_history: high-risk history-preserving correction with full revalidation

lifecycle_boundaries.sr_rfc_independence: link/unlink never opens, closes, restarts, cancels, archives, or otherwise cascades either ticket lifecycle
lifecycle_boundaries.terminal_rfc: accepted terminal provider evidence updates the governed RFC projection and may create a pending cascade proposal; it does not itself execute Task/Objective/Communication consequences
lifecycle_boundaries.archive: RFC archival is local/reversible presentation state and source reconciliation continues while archived
lifecycle_boundaries.hard_delete: only a provably untouched manual draft may be hard-deleted under identity/provenance/relationship/WFM/audit guards
lifecycle_boundaries.terminal_reversal: source reversal/correction is reviewed and history-preserving rather than synthetic reopen

delegated_design.HLD-05: official workbook discovery, source observation, staging, adoption proposals, current source-field reconciliation
delegated_design.HLD-06: WFM/Local Task identity, planning, execution, Objective membership and cascade Task/Objective consequences
delegated_design.HLD-09: Device Reference regularization/resolution to Network Element and Infrastructure ownership
delegated_design.HLD-10: Communication links and terminal-cascade communication consequences
delegated_design.HLD-07: SR Product Line/SLA classification and SLA lifecycle projections
delegated_design.LLD-03: ticket/RFC/relationship/notes schemas, commands, queries and workbench-facing projections
